about_the_game:
The complete soundtrack of FINAL FANTASY TACTICS is now available!

This collection features total of 102 songs: 71 tracks from FINAL FANTASY TACTICS Original Soundtrack released in 2006, and 31 previously unreleased tracks.

The cover art showcases newly illustrated key art for FINAL FANTASY TACTICS – The Ivalice Chronicles by Akihiko Yoshida.

Relive the emotional melodies of this legendary tactical RPG masterpiece!
